name: ListArtifacts

parameters.help_en: The name of the digital employee
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The artifact path from which to list artifacts. If this parameter is not specified, artifacts are listed from the root directory
parameters.name: artifact_path

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return. If more results are available, the response includes a `nextToken` to retrieve the next page
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. You can obtain this token from the `nextToken` parameter of a previous response
parameters.name: next_token
